rationale: I read the complete held EO 11767 (39 FR 6603, Feb. 21, 1974): a single designation of the Organization of African Unity as a public international organization under the International Organizations Immunities Act; no own term, no other provisions. I read the complete held EO 13377 (70 FR 20263, Apr. 18, 2005): sec. 1 designates the African Union under the IOIA, sec. 2 non-abridgement (of the AU's own privileges), and sec. 3 'Revocation. Executive Order 11767 of February 19, 1974, is revoked.' The revocation is express, whole and unconditional; the non-abridgement clause concerns the AU's privileges and does not save any part of EO 11767; there is no effective-date delay. Earlier endings: none; EO 11767 is not amended by any order in the history. D6 (later events): the history has one revocation event (EV:LE-75d2140f051b / the duplicate 'Revokes' line) and an empty 1989 snapshot; no event amends, extends or revives EO 11767, and I found no held order naming it after April 2005. The eCFR current-law lead is a pointer without a held text and is not used. Provisional NO hypothesis only.
